notes: attempt-1: exploratory (station-name matching, merges, missingness; no RESULT lines). attempt-2: first full estimation; fixest's default dropped date fixed-effect singletons (N 240/98). Final: same specification with fixef.rm='none' so N counts every station-visit, as OLS with date dummies would (242/102). Coefficients are identical; the change was made for a method reason, not by comparison with any paper value (none were seen). Spec: OLS of panhandlers per visit on monthly station exits (passersby.csv merged on station-month-year; Georgetown assigned Foggy Bottom's counts), station mean of each passerby's friendliest response (highest marked category 1-5), shuttle indicator (shuttlemin<=10) and service indicator (servicemin<=10), visit-date FE, SEs clustered by station; five-station subsample = Farragut North, Farragut West, Gallery Place, McPherson Square, Metro Center. Receipts: donations/minutes*60 (N=80); (cash+inkind)/minutes*60, keeping rows with both non-missing (N=67). Brown-Forsythe = car::leveneTest(center=median); one-way ANOVA via aov.
